Eli (People Ops): Heads-up — mandatory privacy refresher + evidence sweep kicks off this Thu 09:00 PT. All employees must complete the 20-min microtraining by the deadline and teams must submit at least one SOC2-relevant artifact or an evidence-owner ticket.
Eli (People Ops): Deadline: 2026-06-05 17:00 PT. Calendar invite + checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-refresh (please RSVP).
Naomi (Security): FYI our audit sampling will target ~10% of teams for deeper review. If your team gets sampled, we'll ask for extra artifacts (logs, key rotation records).
Devon (SRE): For infra, which logs are acceptable? We have rotation events in CloudWatch and KMS rotate logs.
Naomi (Security): Both are fine. Prefer exported JSON/CSV slices with timestamps. If you include KMS rotation, add a short note about the rotation policy version.
Zoe (Sales): What about customer-facing teams — do AE/CS need to upload anything beyond cert?
Eli (People Ops): AE/CS only need training certs + a brief note if you store customer PII in shared docs (link the doc).
Hannah (Legal): If you reference contracts as artifacts, redact customer names or use internal IDs. We can help with redaction — escalate to legal-review ticket.
Training Bot: Reminder: microtraining assigned: "Privacy Refresher 2026" — completion tracked automatically. Link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Devon (SRE): Timeline conflict: we have a rollout on Fri morning. Can infra request a narrow delay?
Eli (People Ops): We can approve a 48-hour rolling extension for teams with release windows. Create a ticket titled: `TEAM - Compliance extension request - <reason>` and tag @Naomi.
Compliance Bot: Auto-checks will run 72h before close. Teams with missing items will receive DMs and an @here alert in #people-ops.
Naomi (Security): Quick operational note: if you submit a ticket as your artifact (owner assigned, ETA included), that satisfies the requirement for the sweep — auditors accept owner-assigned tickets while evidence is in progress.
Devon (SRE): Putting in `infra` ticket now: `infra - evidence owner: Devon - KMS rotation export arriving 2026-06-04`
Zoe (Sales): Contractor question: do contractors take the microtraining or can managers attest?
Eli (People Ops): Contractors: one of two options — they complete the microtraining and upload cert, or the manager adds a signed attestation note in the ticket. We need one of those for audit sampling.
Hannah (Legal): Also add any NDA/POA references if contractors have restricted access.
Naomi (Security): If you're unsure about what to upload, use these quick artifact examples:
```
- Config snapshot (JSON/CSV)
- Scheduled-backup manifest with timestamps
- KMS/key rotation log (export)
- Service account IAM export
- Redacted contract or internal doc link + owner
- Ticket with explicit evidence owner + ETA
```
Eli (People Ops): Office hours scheduled Thu 12:00-13:00 PT with PMs from Security & Legal — calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/2026-compliance-office-hours. Drop by if you need help packaging artifacts.
Training Bot: Teams with <80% completion by deadline will receive a follow-up assignment.
Naomi (Security): If your team is selected for deep review, we'll ping the evidence owner and request an artifact bundle within 48h.
Devon (SRE): Uploaded infra exports to /attestations/2026/infra/; ticket created.
Zoe (Sales): Sales uploaded attestation note for contractors.
Eli (People Ops): Thank you — we'll post a 24h reminder and then a final @here 6h before close. Please reach out if anything blocks you. :pray:
